ex.en: All employees will get a year-end bonus.
ex.zh: 所有員工都會領到年終獎金。

ex.en: She received a bonus for reaching her sales target.
ex.zh: 她因為達成業績目標而拿到獎金。

bonus.en: extra money paid to a worker in addition to normal pay

ex.en: The hotel is near the beach, which is a bonus.
ex.zh: 這家飯店離海灘很近，算是額外的好處。

ex.en: As a bonus, the software comes with free updates.
ex.zh: 另外的好處是，這個軟體附有免費更新。

bonus.en: an extra good thing that you did not expect

ex.en: There is a bookstore in front of my house.
ex.zh: 我家前面有一間書店。

ex.en: He bought an English book at a bookstore.
ex.zh: 他在書店買了一本英文書。

ex.en: Why don't we go to the bookstore on foot?
ex.zh: 我們何不走路去書店？

ex.en: This booklet is free of charge.
ex.zh: 這本小冊子是免費的。

ex.en: Please read the instruction booklet carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細閱讀說明手冊。

booklet.en: a thin book with a paper cover that gives information

ex.en: The directors met in the boardroom.
ex.zh: 董事們在會議室開會。

ex.en: Important decisions are made in the boardroom.
ex.zh: 重要決策是在董事會議室裡做出的。

boardroom.en: a room where the leaders of a company hold meetings

ex.en: Visit our booth at the trade show.
ex.zh: 歡迎到商展參觀我們的攤位。

ex.en: We set up a booth at the exhibition.
ex.zh: 我們在展覽會上設了一個攤位。

booth.en: a small area or stand where things are shown or sold

ex.en: Where's the nearest telephone booth?
ex.zh: 最近的電話亭在哪裡？

ex.en: Tom ran and ran, until at last he saw the telephone booth.
ex.zh: 湯姆跑了又跑，終於看到了電話亭。

booth.en: a small closed space for one person to use

ex.en: Such a plan is bound to fail.
ex.zh: 這種計畫注定會失敗。

ex.en: Jack is bound to succeed this time.
ex.zh: 傑克這次一定會成功。

ex.en: Prices are bound to rise next year.
ex.zh: 明年物價一定會上漲。

bound.en: certain to happen or to do something

ex.en: He boarded a plane bound for Los Angeles.
ex.zh: 他搭上了飛往洛杉磯的飛機。

ex.en: This train is bound for Kaohsiung.
ex.zh: 這班列車開往高雄。

bound.zh: 受約束的、有義務的（be bound by）

ex.en: We are bound by the terms of the contract.
ex.zh: 我們受合約條款約束。

ex.en: Employees are legally bound to keep client data confidential.
ex.zh: 員工依法有義務為客戶資料保密。

bound.en: required to obey a rule or promise

ex.en: The ball bounded away into our neighbor's garden.
ex.zh: 球一路彈進了鄰居家的院子。

ex.en: The dog came bounding across the yard.
ex.zh: 狗蹦蹦跳跳地跑過院子。

bound.en: to move forward with big, quick jumps

ex.en: There are a lot of dictionaries in the bookcase.
ex.zh: 書櫃裡有很多字典。

ex.en: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
ex.zh: 這個書櫃組裝起來很容易。

ex.en: Tom can't move this bookcase without a little help.
ex.zh: 沒有人幫忙的話，湯姆搬不動這個書櫃。

bookcase.en: a piece of furniture with shelves for books

ex.en: Borrowers must repay the loan within five years.
ex.zh: 借款人必須在五年內還清貸款。

ex.en: Banks check a borrower's credit history.
ex.zh: 銀行會查核借款人的信用紀錄。

borrower.en: a person who gets money from a bank and must pay it back

ex.en: He boasted of having won the first prize.
ex.zh: 他吹噓自己得了第一名。

ex.en: He boasts that he can speak six languages.
ex.zh: 他誇口說自己會講六種語言。

ex.en: She always boasts of being a good swimmer.
ex.zh: 她老是吹噓自己很會游泳。

boast.en: to talk with too much pride about what you have or can do

ex.en: Switzerland boasts many sights.
ex.zh: 瑞士有許多景點。

ex.en: The hotel boasts a beautiful rooftop pool.
ex.zh: 這家飯店擁有美麗的頂樓泳池。

boast.en: to have something good that people are proud of

ex.en: I'm tired of listening to his boasts.
ex.zh: 我聽膩了他的吹噓。

ex.en: I've had enough of your boasts.
ex.zh: 我受夠了你的自吹自擂。

boast.en: a statement that shows too much pride

ex.en: The CEO made a bold decision.
ex.zh: 執行長做了一個大膽的決定。

ex.en: It was bold of you to ask for a raise.
ex.zh: 你敢開口要求加薪真大膽。

ex.en: The poster uses bold colors.
ex.zh: 這張海報用了醒目的顏色。

ex.en: The logo has strong, bold lines.
ex.zh: 這個標誌的線條粗而鮮明。

ex.en: Important words are printed in bold.
ex.zh: 重要的字用粗體印刷。

ex.en: Please put the title in bold.
ex.zh: 請把標題設成粗體。

bold.en: letters printed thicker and darker than normal

ex.en: Bondholders receive interest twice a year.
ex.zh: 債券持有人每年領兩次利息。

ex.en: The company failed to pay its bondholders.
ex.zh: 這家公司未能償付債券持有人。

bondholder.en: a person who owns a document promising to pay back borrowed money

ex.en: The museum has an old bomber on display.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著一架舊轟炸機。

ex.en: Several bombers flew over the city.
ex.zh: 好幾架轟炸機飛過城市上空。

ex.en: He wore a black leather bomber jacket.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件黑色皮革飛行夾克。

ex.en: Bomber jackets are back in fashion.
ex.zh: 飛行夾克又流行起來了。

bomber.en: a short jacket that is tight at the waist

ex.en: Consumers boycotted the brand after the scandal.
ex.zh: 醜聞爆發後，消費者抵制這個品牌。

ex.en: Several countries boycotted the event.
ex.zh: 有幾個國家杯葛這場活動。

boycott.en: to refuse to buy or use something as a protest

ex.en: The boycott hurt the company's sales.
ex.zh: 這波抵制重創了公司的銷售。

ex.en: Activists called for a boycott of the product.
ex.zh: 社運人士呼籲抵制這項產品。

boycott.en: a protest in which people refuse to buy or use something

ex.en: The good news bolstered investor confidence.
ex.zh: 這個好消息提振了投資人的信心。

ex.en: The company hired more staff to bolster its sales team.
ex.zh: 公司增聘人手來強化業務團隊。

bolster.en: to make something stronger or better

ex.en: The ball bounced off the wall.
ex.zh: 球從牆上彈了回來。

ex.en: The kids were bouncing on the bed.
ex.zh: 孩子們在床上跳來跳去。

bounce.en: to hit a surface and quickly move away from it

ex.en: Tom's check bounced.
ex.zh: 湯姆的支票跳票了。

ex.en: The email bounced because the address was wrong.
ex.zh: 因為地址錯誤，那封郵件被退回了。

bounce.en: to be refused by a bank, or to be sent back as not delivered

ex.en: You'll bounce back.
ex.zh: 你會重新振作起來的。

ex.en: I'm surprised Tom hasn't bounced back by now.
ex.zh: 我很驚訝湯姆到現在還沒恢復過來。

ex.en: Sales bounced back quickly after the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期過後銷售很快就回升了。

bounce.en: to become healthy or successful again after a problem

ex.en: You can buy whichever you like, but not both.
ex.zh: 你喜歡哪個就買哪個，但不能兩個都買。

ex.en: You and I are both students at this school.
ex.zh: 你和我都是這所學校的學生。

ex.en: Tom and I are both on the same team.
ex.zh: 我和湯姆都在同一隊。

both.en: the two people or things together

both.zh: both A and B：A 和 B 都

ex.en: He can speak both English and French very well.
ex.zh: 他英文和法文都說得很好。

ex.en: Both Tom and Amy work in sales.
ex.zh: 湯姆和艾咪都在業務部工作。

both.en: used to show that two things are true together

ex.en: Our bodies respond to our feelings.
ex.zh: 我們的身體會對情緒做出反應。

ex.en: The body quickly adjusts itself to changes in temperature.
ex.zh: 身體能很快適應溫度的變化。

ex.en: The temperature of the human body hovers around 37°C.
ex.zh: 人體溫度大約在攝氏 37 度上下。

body.en: the whole physical form of a person or animal

ex.en: The government set up a new body to oversee safety.
ex.zh: 政府成立了一個新機構來監督安全。

ex.en: The student body voted for a new president.
ex.zh: 全體學生投票選出新會長。

body.en: an organized group of people with a particular job

ex.en: Write your message in the body of the email.
ex.zh: 把你的訊息寫在郵件內文裡。

ex.en: The body of the report is ten pages long.
ex.zh: 報告的正文有十頁。

body.en: the main part of a piece of writing

ex.en: Who is the boy that is swimming over there?
ex.zh: 在那邊游泳的男孩是誰？

ex.en: The boy rode a horse for the first time.
ex.zh: 那個男孩第一次騎馬。

ex.en: This class consists of 15 boys and 28 girls.
ex.zh: 這個班有十五個男生和二十八個女生。

boy.en: a male child or young man

ex.en: There are a lot of eggs in the box.
ex.zh: 這個盒子裡有很多蛋。

ex.en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.
ex.zh: 這個箱子是空的，裡面什麼也沒有。

ex.en: He carried six boxes at a time.
ex.zh: 他一次搬六個箱子。

box.en: a container with straight sides, used for keeping things

ex.en: Please check the box if you agree.
ex.zh: 如果你同意，請勾選這個方框。

ex.en: Write your name in the box below.
ex.zh: 請在下方的格子裡寫上你的名字。

box.en: a small square space on a form where you make a mark

ex.en: We boxed up all the books before moving.
ex.zh: 搬家前我們把所有的書都裝箱了。

ex.en: The orders are boxed and shipped every afternoon.
ex.zh: 訂單每天下午裝箱出貨。

box.en: to put things into containers with straight sides

ex.en: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
ex.zh: 海底有沙子。

ex.en: Put the book on the bottom of the bookshelf.
ex.zh: 把書放在書櫃最下層。

ex.en: She is always at the bottom of the class.
ex.zh: 她在班上總是最後一名。

bottom.zh: from the bottom of one's heart：衷心地

ex.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
ex.zh: 我衷心感謝你。

ex.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart for your help.
ex.zh: 我衷心感謝你的幫忙。

bottom.en: in a way that shows very deep and honest feeling

ex.en: The files are in the bottom drawer.
ex.zh: 檔案在最下面的抽屜。

ex.en: Please sign at the bottom right of the page.
ex.zh: 請在頁面右下角簽名。

bottom.en: at the lowest part of something

ex.en: There were some boats on the lake.
ex.zh: 湖上有幾艘船。

ex.en: I am taking Tom on a boat trip tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要帶湯姆去搭船旅遊。

ex.en: Now, get off the boat and swim to shore.
ex.zh: 現在下船，游到岸邊。

boat.en: a small vehicle that travels on water

ex.en: When the bomb exploded, I happened to be there.
ex.zh: 炸彈爆炸時，我剛好在現場。

ex.en: They defused the bomb before it could blow up.
ex.zh: 他們在炸彈爆炸前就拆除了它。

bomb.en: a weapon that explodes and causes damage

ex.en: London was bombed several times.
ex.zh: 倫敦曾多次遭到轟炸。

ex.en: The bridge was bombed during the war.
ex.zh: 那座橋在戰爭期間遭到轟炸。

bomb.en: to attack a place with explosive weapons

ex.en: The movie bombed at the box office.
ex.zh: 那部電影票房慘敗。

ex.en: His joke totally bombed.
ex.zh: 他的笑話完全冷場。

ex.en: Government bonds are a safe investment.
ex.zh: 政府公債是安全的投資。

ex.en: She invested part of her savings in bonds.
ex.zh: 她把部分存款投資在債券上。

bond.en: a paper in which a government or company promises to pay back borrowed money with interest

ex.en: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
ex.zh: 雖然激情可能使關係緊繃，但絕不能斷了我們之間的情誼。

ex.en: The trip helped build a strong bond between team members.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行讓團隊成員之間建立了深厚的情誼。

bond.en: a close feeling of friendship or connection between people

ex.en: The new employees bonded quickly during training.
ex.zh: 新進員工在訓練期間很快就熟絡起來。

ex.en: Team dinners are a great way to bond with colleagues.
ex.zh: 團隊聚餐是和同事培養感情的好方法。

bond.en: to form a close friendship with someone

ex.en: There is a bottle of wine on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上有一瓶葡萄酒。

ex.en: My mother bought two bottles of orange juice.
ex.zh: 我媽媽買了兩瓶柳橙汁。

ex.en: There are some empty bottles in the box.
ex.zh: 盒子裡有一些空瓶。

bottle.en: a tall container for liquids, or the amount it holds

ex.en: Tom only drinks bottled water.
ex.zh: 湯姆只喝瓶裝水。

ex.en: The wine is bottled in France.
ex.zh: 這款葡萄酒在法國裝瓶。

bottle.en: to put a drink into containers for sale

ex.en: This novel bores me.
ex.zh: 這本小說讓我覺得很無聊。

ex.en: He bores me.
ex.zh: 他讓我覺得很無聊。

ex.en: Mary seems to be bored with the game.
ex.zh: 瑪麗似乎玩這個遊戲玩膩了。

bore.en: to make someone feel tired and uninterested

ex.en: The meeting was a complete bore.
ex.zh: 那場會議無聊透頂。

ex.en: He can be a bit of a bore at parties.
ex.zh: 他在派對上有時有點無趣。

bore.en: a person or thing that is dull and uninteresting

ex.en: Tom broke some bones in his arm and hand.
ex.zh: 湯姆的手臂和手有好幾處骨折。

ex.en: Remember, exercise helps strengthen your muscles and bones.
ex.zh: 記住，運動有助於強化肌肉和骨骼。

ex.en: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
ex.zh: 我被魚刺卡到喉嚨了。

bone.en: one of the hard parts that make up the body's frame

ex.en: I am sorry to bother you at this time.
ex.zh: 很抱歉在這個時間打擾您。

ex.en: Tom said that the noise bothered him.
ex.zh: 湯姆說噪音讓他很困擾。

ex.en: Don't bother your parents with such a pointless thing.
ex.zh: 別拿這種無聊的小事去煩你爸媽。

bother.en: to disturb someone or make them worried or annoyed

ex.en: He took my umbrella without bothering to ask.
ex.zh: 他連問都沒問就拿走了我的雨傘。

ex.en: Don't bother calling me back.
ex.zh: 不用費心回電給我了。

bother.en: to take the time or effort to do something

ex.en: It's no bother at all.
ex.zh: 一點都不麻煩。

ex.en: Sorry to put you to so much bother.
ex.zh: 抱歉給你添了這麼多麻煩。

bother.en: trouble or effort that is a little annoying

ex.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.
ex.zh: 老闆對你的工作評價很高。

ex.en: She is my boss and also my best friend.
ex.zh: 她是我的上司，也是我最好的朋友。

ex.en: Ya-wen nailed her proposal yesterday. The boss kept nodding.
ex.zh: 雅雯昨天的提案超穩，老闆一直點頭。

boss.en: the person in charge of workers at a job

boss.zh: boss around：對人頤指氣使、使喚

ex.en: Don't let yourself be bossed around by her.
ex.zh: 別讓她對你頤指氣使。

ex.en: Stop bossing me around!
ex.zh: 別再使喚我了！

boss.en: to keep telling people what to do in a rude way

ex.en: I would like to borrow fifty dollars from you.
ex.zh: 我想跟你借五十塊。

ex.en: I'd like to borrow your notes for a bit.
ex.zh: 我想借你的筆記看一下。

ex.en: My pride prevented me from borrowing money from him.
ex.zh: 自尊心讓我開不了口跟他借錢。

borrow.en: to take something from someone and promise to give it back

ex.en: English has borrowed many words from French.
ex.zh: 英文從法文借用了很多字。

ex.en: The design borrows ideas from Japanese gardens.
ex.zh: 這個設計借鏡了日式庭園的概念。

borrow.en: to take a word or idea from another language or source and use it

ex.en: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
ex.zh: 我家院子和鄰居家之間有一道籬笆作為分界線。

ex.en: The river forms the boundary between the two cities.
ex.zh: 這條河是兩座城市的分界線。

boundary.en: a line that marks the edge of an area

ex.en: I don't like people who have no sense of boundaries.
ex.zh: 我很討厭沒有分寸的人。

ex.en: It's important to set clear boundaries between work and family.
ex.zh: 在工作和家庭之間劃清界線很重要。

boundary.en: a limit that shows what behavior is acceptable

ex.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
ex.zh: 我想買一雙滑雪靴。

ex.en: He scraped the mud off his boots.
ex.zh: 他把靴子上的泥巴刮掉。

boot.en: a strong shoe that covers the foot and ankle

ex.en: My laptop takes a long time to boot up.
ex.zh: 我的筆電開機要很久。

ex.en: Try booting the computer in safe mode.
ex.zh: 試著用安全模式啟動電腦。

boot.en: to start a computer so it is ready to use

ex.en: I'd like mapo tofu and two bowls of rice, please.
ex.zh: 我要麻婆豆腐和兩碗白飯，謝謝。

ex.en: A bowl of rice is about 180 grams.
ex.zh: 一碗飯大約一百八十公克。

ex.en: Don't fill up your bowl with too much food.
ex.zh: 別把碗裡的飯盛得太滿。

bowl.en: a deep round dish for food, or the food in it

ex.en: Although I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
ex.zh: 雖然我喜歡打保齡球，但最近都沒去打。

ex.en: We went bowling after work on Friday.
ex.zh: 我們星期五下班後去打保齡球。

bowl.en: to play a game of rolling a heavy ball at pins

ex.en: The new ad campaign boosted sales by 30%.
ex.zh: 新的廣告活動讓銷售額提升了 30%。

ex.en: Exercise can boost your energy.
ex.zh: 運動可以提振你的精神。

ex.en: The government wants to boost the economy.
ex.zh: 政府想要刺激經濟。

boost.en: to make something increase or improve

ex.en: The win gave the team a big boost.
ex.zh: 這場勝利給了球隊很大的鼓舞。

ex.en: Tourism gave the local economy a boost.
ex.zh: 觀光業帶動了當地經濟。

boost.en: something that helps increase or improve something

ex.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
ex.zh: 他在上一波景氣繁榮時靠炒股賺了一大筆錢。

ex.en: The city is enjoying a tourism boom.
ex.zh: 這座城市正迎來觀光熱潮。

boom.en: a period of fast growth in business and money

ex.en: Online shopping has boomed in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來網路購物蓬勃發展。

ex.en: Business is booming this summer.
ex.zh: 今年夏天生意非常興隆。

boom.en: to grow quickly and become very successful

ex.en: We heard a loud boom from the construction site.
ex.zh: 我們聽到工地傳來一聲巨響。

ex.en: The boom of thunder woke me up.
ex.zh: 隆隆雷聲把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Ebola spreads from person to person through bodily fluids.
ex.zh: 伊波拉病毒透過體液在人與人之間傳播。

ex.en: Stress can cause bodily pain.
ex.zh: 壓力可能造成身體疼痛。

ex.en: The bodyguard was wearing an earpiece.
ex.zh: 保鏢戴著耳機。

ex.en: The singer arrived at the hotel with two bodyguards.
ex.zh: 那位歌手在兩名保鏢陪同下抵達飯店。

bodyguard.en: a person whose job is to protect an important person

ex.en: The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.
ex.zh: 海底巨石的裂縫裡藏著一隻章魚。

ex.en: A huge boulder blocked the mountain road.
ex.zh: 一塊巨石擋住了山路。

ex.en: The kids climbed on the boulders by the river.
ex.zh: 孩子們在河邊的大石頭上攀爬。

ex.en: My boyfriend still hasn't been to the Great Wall.
ex.zh: 我男朋友還沒有去過長城。

ex.en: Tom wanted to know if Mary had a boyfriend.
ex.zh: 湯姆想知道瑪麗是否有男朋友？

ex.en: She is going to part from her boyfriend.
ex.zh: 她要跟男朋友分手了。

boyfriend.en: a man or boy in a romantic relationship with someone

ex.en: I made a booking for two nights.
ex.zh: 我訂了兩晚。

ex.zh: 你可以在網路上更改預訂。

ex.en: The boa wrapped itself around a branch and waited.
ex.zh: 那條蟒蛇纏在樹枝上靜靜等待。

ex.en: A boa is not poisonous, but it can squeeze its prey.
ex.zh: 蟒蛇沒有毒，但會絞緊獵物。

ex.en: She wore a pink feather boa to the costume party.
ex.zh: 她戴著粉紅色羽毛圍巾去參加變裝派對。

ex.en: The singer tossed her boa into the cheering crowd.
ex.zh: 歌手把她的羽毛圍巾拋向歡呼的人群。

ex.en: My bossy little sister tells everyone what to do.
ex.zh: 我愛指使人的妹妹對每個人下指令。

ex.en: Don't be so bossy; let others share their ideas.
ex.zh: 別那麼愛指使人，讓別人也說說想法。

ex.en: The car's bodywork was damaged in the crash.
ex.zh: 這輛車的車身在撞擊中受損。

ex.en: He took the car to a shop for bodywork repairs.
ex.zh: 他把車送去修車廠做車身修復。

ex.en: They live in the borderland between two countries.
ex.zh: 他們住在兩國之間的邊境地帶。

ex.en: This book describes life in the borderland between city and farm.
ex.zh: 這本書描寫城市與農田交界地帶的生活。

ex.en: The kids jumped on the bouncy castle all afternoon.
ex.zh: 孩子們整個下午都在充氣彈跳屋上跳。

ex.en: She walked into the room with a bouncy, cheerful step.
ex.zh: 她以輕快有活力的腳步走進房間。

ex.en: A bobcat crossed the trail just before sunset.
ex.zh: 一隻短尾貓在日落前穿過了小徑。

ex.en: The bobcat is smaller than a mountain lion.
ex.zh: 短尾貓比美洲獅小。

ex.en: The noise from the street is really bothersome at night.
ex.zh: 夜裡街上的噪音真的很擾人。

ex.en: Filling out these forms is a bothersome task.
ex.zh: 填寫這些表格是件麻煩事。

ex.en: The bodybuilder trains at the gym six days a week.
ex.zh: 那位健美選手每週到健身房訓練六天。

ex.en: My cousin wants to become a professional bodybuilder.
ex.zh: 我表哥想成為職業健美運動員。

ex.en: The garden path was lined with a neat boxwood hedge.
ex.zh: 花園小徑兩旁種著整齊的黃楊木矮籬。

ex.en: The chess pieces were carved from boxwood.
ex.zh: 這些西洋棋子是用黃楊木雕成的。

ex.en: I used a ticket as a bookmark.
ex.zh: 我拿一張票券當書籤。

ex.en: She slid the bookmark into the book and closed it.
ex.zh: 她把書籤夾進書裡，然後闔上書。
